label: Herder help side effects
summary: Rolls for a good or bad side effect of the Kurultai council task that helps herders.
details: Runs only if the character does not yet have the variable had_kurultai_task_side_effect. Only 1 percent of firings roll at all (chance_to_happen = 1). When they do, 'no event' has weight 1000 against 100 for each of four events: two bad ones (kurultai_task.1050, .1055) and two good ones (kurultai_task.1000, .1005). The task name is read from the key and the event prefix; the input does not state it.

label: Increase control side effects
summary: Rolls for a good or bad side effect of a council task that increases county control.
details: Blocked if the character already has the variable had_marshal_task_side_effect or had_kurultai_task_side_effect. It also needs a marshal on the council, or a Kurultai councillor (scope:councillor) who is performing one of the four Kurultai control tasks. Only 1 percent of firings roll at all; then 'no event' has weight 1000. Bad outcomes (vanilla comments): lower county opinion (marshal_task.3001), loss of control (3002, weight 50), baron opinion loss (3003). Good outcomes: higher county opinion (3101), baron opinion gain (3102). Unless noted, each has weight 100.

label: Integrate title side effects
summary: Rolls for a good or bad side effect of the chancellor's task of integrating a title.
details: Runs only if the character does not yet have the variable had_chancellor_task_side_effect and has a chancellor on the council. Vanilla's chancellor task fires it through its monthly_on_action. Only 1 percent of firings roll at all; then 'no event' has weight 1000. Bad outcomes (weight 50 each, vanilla comments): nobles resist integration, the culture is upset. Good outcomes (weight 150 each): nobles endorse it, the culture endorses it, or a choice between development and integration.

label: Manage astrologer task
summary: Passes on to the astrologer task's side effects when the character has a Kurultai councillor.
details: It rolls nothing itself. If any of the four Kurultai councillor slots is filled, it fires task_manage_astrologer_side_effects, which does the rolling. Vanilla's Kurultai astrologer task fires this one through its monthly_on_action.

label: Astrologer side effects

Fired by task_manage_astrologer_on_action.

label: Tengri pilgrimage arrival
summary: Picks an event for a pilgrim of the Tengri religion who arrives at a pilgrimage destination.
details: Only runs for a character whose religion is Tengrism. Two events with equal weight: 'Blue Open Skies' (pilgrimage.5911) and 'Meet the Mystic again' (pilgrimage.4002). Vanilla lists it inside pilgrimage_arrival_events, which tries the religion-specific arrival lists in order and uses the first one that is valid.

label: Burdensome taxes contract
summary: Creates the 'Burdensome Taxes' governance contract in one of the realm's counties.
details: Runs only if the cooldown flag task_contract_cooldown_burdensome_taxes is not set and some county of the realm has a province with a holding other than the governor's capital. It saves one such province as scope:target_province, creates the contract there (tier from scope:governance_task_contract_tier), sets the cooldown flag for 10 years and runs the shared set-up effect. It reads scope:governor and the tier scope, which must already be saved when it fires. Vanilla's celestial civic contract list picks it with weight 100.

label: China yearly events
summary: Picks a yearly event for characters in the Chinese (TGP) setting: movement, dynastic cycle or Confucian events.
details: Needs the TGP DLC, and the character must have a government with the flag government_is_celestial or a dynastic cycle participant group (top_participant_group:dynastic_cycle). Only 50 percent of firings pick at all (chance_to_happen = 50). Events come from three groups: movement events (tgp_movement_events), dynastic cycle events (tgp_dynastic_cycle_events) and Confucianism events (tgp_china_yearly), with weights from 100 to 250. Event 0120 is commented out; its comment calls it a feast event. Vanilla's yearly on_action list picks it with weight 6.

details: Runs only if the cooldown flag task_contract_cooldown_combat_train_monks is not set and some county of the realm has a church-holding province other than the governor's capital. It saves such a province as scope:target_province, creates the contract there, sets the cooldown for 10 years and runs the shared set-up effect. label: Confusion of tongues contract

details: Needs the cooldown flag unset, a coastal province with a holding (not the governor's capital) in the realm, and some county in the region world_asia_and_india that has a coastal province and whose culture does not have the Chinese heritage pillar. The contract is placed in a coastal holding province of the realm. The cooldown is 10 years; the shared set-up effect runs afterwards.

details: Runs only if the 10-year cooldown flag is not set and the realm has a province with a holding (not the governor's capital) of one of those four terrains. The contract is placed in such a province; then the cooldown is set and the shared set-up effect runs.

Its weight_multiplier is base 1, plus 10 if the character it runs on has the education_stewardship trait. Vanilla's natural disaster list picks it with weight 100.

label: Escaped justice contract
summary: Creates the 'Escaped Justice' governance contract and makes a baron vassal of the governor its target.
details: Needs the cooldown flag unset, a province without a holding (farmland, forest or hills, not the governor's capital) in the realm, and a vassal of the governor whose highest title is a barony and who is not travelling, imprisoned or commanding an army. The escapee is the vassal ranked highest by greed minus half their honor, so greedy, dishonorable ones come first. They are saved as scope:escapee and set as the contract's target; the location is a matching province saved as scope:target_province. Then the 10-year cooldown is set and the shared set-up effect runs.

label: Japan poetry events

details: Needs the TGP DLC and an available character (is_available). The chance to pick at all is 100 percent (chance_to_happen = 100). Three events with equal weight: Imperial Immortality (1261), An Exchange of Verses (1262), Ephemeral Beauty in the Wilds (1263), all in tgp_japan_yearly_events.

label: Japan yearly events
summary: Picks a yearly event for characters of Japanese culture, with a capital in the Japan region, or with a Japanese government.
details: Needs the TGP DLC, plus one of: a culture with the Japonic heritage, a capital province in the world_asia_japan region, or a Japanese government (government_is_japanese_trigger). Only 50 percent of firings pick at all. About 27 distinct events from tgp_japan_yearly_events, weights 5 to 200 (rare ones like the Yokai encounter have 5, 'A Poetic Life' 200). Events 1090, 1100 and 1110 are listed twice in the file; what the game does with a repeated entry is not documented in the input. Vanilla's yearly on_action list picks it with weight 6.

label: Manage talent task
summary: Once a year, may find a talented person in the realm and appoint them to a court position, for the Manage Talent minister task.
details: Needs the TGP DLC. The effect works only in month 1 and then rolls a percentage chance given by task_manage_talent_scale_tooltip_total_value. It collects courtiers and guests of the liege's vassals (county rank or higher) and of the liege's own court, plus the capital's character pool, whose total skills reach the 'poor' threshold. It then checks a fixed list of court positions in order (physician, travel leader, grand mentor and others) and takes the first one the liege can fill and for which a candidate has enough aptitude (2 or 3 depending on the position). The best-aptitude valid candidate is hired if needed and appointed, with a toast. It expects scope:councillor_liege and scope:councillor to be saved by the council task, which fires it monthly.

label: Missing equipment contract
summary: Creates the 'Missing Equipment' governance contract in the capital.
details: Runs only if the 10-year cooldown flag is not set and no province of the realm has the tgp_well_equipped_soldiers_modifier or tgp_greatly_equipped_soldiers_modifier. It does not pick a county: the capital province is the location (a vanilla comment says the equipment is likely kept there). Then the cooldown is set and the shared set-up effect runs.
